description: How the owner thinks, focuses, feels, works, learns, and behaves under pressure: personality typing, Big Five with BFI-2 facets, temperament, cognitive/working/learning style, emotional and social style, strengths, blind spots, and behavior under pressure.
title: Personality

description: The owner's interests, tastes, media, food and lifestyle, tools, aesthetics, and dislikes: the topical likes that personalize suggestions, distinct from how they like to be worked with (Working Style) and their competencies (Skills).
title: Preferences

description: Who the owner is, in twelve facets: eleven of the stable self, from Working Style and Biography to Finances and Health, and the dynamic Focus layer, the foundation for personalized, contextually appropriate help. Read it before using or recording anything about the owner, for where each fact goes and how it is read and written with discretion.
title: 🪪 PROFILE

description: The owner's relational self and social world: family and household structure, the roles they hold, their social network, attachment and relational style, and key contacts. The individual people themselves live in Memory; this holds the relational self.
title: Relationships

description: The owner's competencies and the per-domain expertise map that calibrates how much to explain: skip the basics where the owner is expert, define terms where they are new. Read it before explaining anything, to pitch the depth to the owner's level in that domain.
title: 🛠️ SKILLS

description: What the owner cares about and how they decide what is right: core values, orientation axes, life philosophy, ethics, motivation, purpose, role models, and what they stand for and against, plus held beliefs as sensitive entries. Read it when weighing options or giving advice.
title: 🧭 VALUES

description: How the owner likes to work with anyone who works with them, a person or an AI: how to address them, the do's, don'ts, tone, length, and format rules followed in every reply, plus communication, terminology, feedback, and decision style. The facet acted on most.
title: Working Style

description: Explains the purpose of the Projects/ folder: personal project tracking, one folder per project copied whole from a standard template, created only with a yes, with each project's status in its own Overview.md. Read it before starting, filing or updating a personal project.
title: 🛠️ PROJECTS

description: The generated catalog of every note, drawn by update-vault.py and committed: machine-written, never hand-edited. Read it to learn what the catalog holds and how it stays current, never for rules.
title: 💾 DATA

description: The owner's standing settings, the workflow map and the generated catalog, and the priority order when settings conflict; the vault's scripts live in .github/scripts/. Read it before changing a setting, writing a vault script or reporting on the vault itself.
title: ⚙️ SYSTEM

description: The map of the vault's recurring workflows: the strategy, capture and consolidation loops, and where every other recurring procedure is defined.
title: System Workflows

description: Explains the purpose of the Ventures/ folder: one subfolder per venture, each holding that company's full context and department folders. Read it before creating a venture folder or doing any work for a company the owner runs.
title: 🏢 VENTURES
